reviewedTemplateChanges: Add a shared non-killing install/uninstall guard macro that reports/refuses with exit code 2.
Replace the stock CheckIfAppIsRunning call in Install with a second bounded port guard check.
Replace the stock CheckIfAppIsRunning call in Uninstall with a second bounded port guard check.

Register {{additional_plugins_path}} above the hooks include, so the nsis_tauri_utils::FindProcessCurrentUser call compiled out of installer-process.nsh resolves instead of failing with 'Plugin not found'.

Announce that early registration with !define DSH_ADDITIONAL_PLUGINS_REGISTERED and guard the stock !addplugindir "${ADDITIONALPLUGINSPATH}" site with !ifndef: a second registration of a directory that already supplied a resolved plugin makes the next command naming it abort with 'Plugin command nsis_tauri_utils::SemverCompare conflicts with a plugin in another directory!', even when the path is identical.

Declare Var PassiveMode/Var UpdateMode and !define DSH_TEMPLATE_MODE_VARS_DECLARED immediately above the hooks include, and drop the stock duplicate declarations below it: installer-process.nsh reads $UpdateMode where it is compiled, while a second Var for one name aborts with 'Error: variable ... already declared'.
unsupportedUpgradeBoundary: The ordinary upgrade path may invoke a pre-existing uninstaller through ExecWait, in both the NSIS and the WiX branches. The new template guards do not protect those previously installed uninstaller bytes, which may retain a stock name-based killing branch, so the ordinary upgrade paths remain unsupported until separately qualified.
